Name: CP Joja
Author: OngkrubG
Description:
A mod that change Joja into CP, a megacorp in real-life Thailand. Main goal of this mod is to mock the capitalism system of "CP" that take over almost any industry they can take, from animal food to telecommunication company.

[size=4][b]here is a list of things changed by this mod.[/b][/size]
- JojaMart
- A Truck aside Joja mart, into typical Thai "Ten Wheel"
- Joja Ruin 
- Joja Warehouse
- Joja Cinema
- Joja Cola into "CP Refresh"
- A Joja's poster in Bus
- Shane's Joja Mart Uniform
- Mails Dialogue that include Joja
- NPC Dialogue (like when Lewis tell us about Joja)
- cutscenes that included Joja
- Joja Membership into "CP All Membership".(like in real-life!)(If you are Thai that often go to 7-11 you will understand this lol.)
- Joja Furniture(like trophies and cola dispenser)

[size=4][b]and here is a list of things to be changed/added in the future. (Just Fixes and some Idea because the mod is mostly completed.)
[/b][/size]- Get rid of Joja and change them into CP if any of them left.
- Maybe Morris, but this should take me some of my valuable times.
- More CP Characteristic in all CP buildings
- and maybe Marnie's farm, to mock CP's animal industry.(If you are Thai you will understand it lol.)
- xnb file for modding with no SMAPI(It is not here yet because I am lazy hehe.)

[b]and here is a list of known issues.[/b]
-v.1.1.0-v.1.3.0 > "Joja cola" that exist in inventory before loading these version and became "CP Refresh" will not stack with new "CP Refresh" obtain after loading this version. (I have to do a lot of research before I can fix this eh, but it can fix easily by get rid of old "Joja Cola".)
-This replaced a lot of sprite including town, item, furniture, machine, food, and dialogue. So,
[size=5]this mod go best with vanilla game or mod that does not change town graphic, cutscene, and story[/size][size=3],
[b]and here is list of reported incompatible mods[/b]
[/size]- [CP] Fox Dog Replacer > Just delete Cursors.png from one of the mod folder, (Up to you hehe) but deleting from this mod will make Joja warehouse and Joja Award cutscene remain the same, else if you delete from "Fox" mod, fox Icon in New Game scene will remains to be dog icon.


Sorry for weird frequent update, new idea and discovery show up every minutes and I have to do it, and here, all Joja's in game became CP, this mod is complete(Unless I found out some part didn't load, or some Joja part i didn't know, because honestly, I didn't test a lot, so....
[size=6]be sure to report bug or any Joja if there is any of them left![/size][size=3](and if possible, please send screenshot!)[/size]


[size=6]and at last, SMAPI and Content Patcher Required!

[/size][size=4][b]***disclaimer >>> I do not own the original logo of so-called "CP", it belongs to the real-world company of CP Group(Charoen Pokphand Group)  and I didn't meant to make profit or money from the creation of this mod. If CP's guy see this, please keep in mind that we, Thai people, love you so much for what you give to our country and community, jub jub.[/b][/size]
